ria_backend: Heads-up: onboarding users hit intermittent 429s with sample-pager when STS rotates and retry+prefetch interact. Repro attached in sampleapp.

tom_go: can you paste the minimal flow? is it the same "auth inside generate" pattern?

ria_backend: yep. pager.prefetch=3. Generate() triggers Token.refresh synchronously in Go SDK. While refresh blocks, pager keeps pulling pages -> backlog floods the client once refresh finishes.

ria_backend: minimal pseudo: 
```go
for p := range pager.Pages() {
  client.Generate(ctx, p.Items()) // may call token.Refresh() which blocks
}
```

dan_devx: JS & Py behave better because refresh yields, so fewer bursts. sounds like an SDK parity bug.

tom_go: quick logs: 
[12:10:01] pager: page 4 queued (prefetch=3)
[12:10:01] token: refresh start
[12:10:02] pager: page 5 queued
[12:10:02] client: concurrency window=7 (limit=3)
[12:10:02] backend: 429 transient

katie_docs: Proposed fixes: lower sampleapp prefetch default to 1, add a docs note about auth-backpressure, and implement a short-term yield in Go SDK after token refresh.

tom_go: plan: (A) add small goroutine hand-off after refresh so caller goroutine yields; (B) add opt-in pager.FetchBlocking flag so apps can disable prefetch. Will add tests simulating flaky STS.

dan_devx: please add a tiny repro in sampleapp and a README note. Also file a DEVEX ticket with logs.

ci-bot: created DEVEX-1155 "go-sdk-auth-refresh-yield" and attached log snippet.

ria_backend: thanks — i'll drop the sampleapp patch and a short repro today.
